about: Homework for this pillar, one list per AI (Claude writes it; tools/kit/render.py in jpavia10/prometheus-hub turns it into docs/agents/QUEUE_{ai}.md and the Drive docs). Every task says exactly what to read, what to make, how many, where to save it, how Claude checks it and what makes it not done. A task is done only when the file passes the checks, never because it was sent.

tasks.title: Scan the house with a phone: 8 apps compared on 10 fixed columns
tasks.why: The house on the stand is placeholder boxes. The real model will come from Joseph scanning rooms with his phone.
inputs: each app's own site, App Store / Play listing and help pages
steps: Compare exactly these 8: Polycam, Scaniverse, Magicplan, RoomScan Pro, Canvas (Occipital), Matterport (phone capture), Metascan, KIRI Engine.

Columns, exactly: app | iPhone LiDAR needed (yes/no/optional) | Android | room floor plan with measurements (yes/no) | export formats (list) | GLB or USDZ export on the free plan | price per month (USD) | accuracy the maker states (with its words) | max area per scan | source URLs.
Every cell from the maker's own page, with the URL in the last column.

deliver.shape: one markdown table, 8 rows x 10 columns

tasks.done_when: 8 rows, 80 filled cells, every price and format on the cited page.
checks: Claude opens the source URL of every price and export cell for 4 apps at random.
rejected_if: a row copied from another row with the names changed
a source URL that does not open or does not say what the row claims
fewer items than the count
a file saved anywhere but the folder named here, or under another name
a blank cell without 'not stated' and the page you checked

tasks.title: The renovation data shape: JSON Schema + 3 made-up projects that pass it
tasks.why: Projects, rooms and notes are empty on purpose. They need one shape before anything is saved.
steps: Write a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) with: house, room (name, floor, size in feet and inches, photos), project (room, title, state: idea / quoted / booked / doing / done, budget, start, finish), task, cost_line (what, vendor, quote, paid, date, receipt photo), vendor (name, trade, phone optional), photo (file, room, date, before/after).
Write 3 made-up projects (a bathroom, a deck, a paint job) as one JSON file that passes the schema.
tasks.done_when: The schema is valid draft 2020-12 and all 3 examples pass it.
rejected_if: an example that fails its own schema
a real address, name or phone number

tasks.title: 60 renovation unit costs, each with two retailer product pages
tasks.why: Hearth will price projects. It needs real unit prices, not ranges from articles.
steps: Pick 60 common line items (drywall sheet 4x8 1/2 in, joint compound 4.5 gal, interior paint 1 gal, primer, LVP per sq ft, ceramic tile per sq ft, thinset, grout, 2x4x8 stud, plywood 3/4, insulation batt R-13, outlet, GFCI outlet, light switch, LED recessed light, toilet, vanity 30 in, faucet, PEX 1/2 in 100 ft, shut-off valve, exterior door, interior door slab, door hinge, baseboard per ft, caulk, construction adhesive, deck screws 5 lb, concrete 80 lb bag, mulch 2 cu ft, smoke alarm ... up to 60).
For each: one Home Depot and one Lowe's product page (homedepot.com/p/... and lowes.com/pd/...), the model or SKU, the price shown, the unit, and the date you saw it.
checks: Claude opens 15 product pages at random (prices drift: within 20 % passes).
rejected_if: fewer rows than the count, or a row missing a field of the shape
a row copied from another row with the names changed
a URL that does not open, is a front page or a search page, or does not say what the row claims
a quote that is not on the page it cites (Claude opens 10 rows at random)
a file saved anywhere but the folder named here, or under another name
a price from an article or a cost guide instead of a product page

tasks.title: 30 IRC 2021 rules a homeowner renovating hits, with section numbers
tasks.why: Hearth's project checklist should warn before a rule is broken (stairs, egress, GFCI, smoke alarms).
steps: From the International Residential Code 2021 on codes.iccsafe.org/content/IRC2021P2 (free read view), pick 30 rules: stair rise/run/headroom, handrail height, guard height, egress window size and sill, smoke and CO alarm placement, GFCI and AFCI locations, bathroom ventilation, ceiling height, deck ledger, water heater relief valve, etc.
For each: section number (e.g. R311.7.5.1), the rule in one sentence, every number in it with its unit, the URL and the quote.

deliver.shape: [{"n":1,"section":"R311.7.5.1","topic":"stair riser height","rule":"riser height not more than 7 3/4 in","numbers":[{"value":7.75,"unit":"in","max":true}],"url":"https://codes.iccsafe.org/content/IRC2021P2/...","quote":"..."}]

rejected_if: fewer rows than the count, or a row missing a field of the shape
a row copied from another row with the names changed
a URL that does not open, is a front page or a search page, or does not say what the row claims
a quote that is not on the page it cites (Claude opens 10 rows at random)
a file saved anywhere but the folder named here, or under another name
a rule from a blog instead of the code text
a section number that does not exist in IRC 2021

tasks.title: 50 recurring home maintenance tasks with intervals from an authoritative source
tasks.why: Kairos and Hearth will put house upkeep on the calendar; each interval must come from a manufacturer, a university extension service, FEMA, EPA or the US Fire Administration.
steps: 50 tasks (HVAC filter, water heater flush, smoke alarm test and battery, dryer vent clean, gutter clean, sump pump test, GFCI test, caulk check, roof check, chimney sweep, garage door balance ...).
For each: interval in days (or season), why, the source page and the quote with the interval.

deliver.shape: [{"n":1,"task":"test smoke alarms","interval_days":30,"season":null,"why":"...","url":"https://www.usfa.fema.gov/...","quote":"Test smoke alarms at least once a month"}]

rejected_if: fewer rows than the count, or a row missing a field of the shape
a row copied from another row with the names changed
a URL that does not open, is a front page or a search page, or does not say what the row claims
a quote that is not on the page it cites (Claude opens 10 rows at random)
a file saved anywhere but the folder named here, or under another name
an interval from a home-improvement blog

tasks.title: 15 material quantity formulas with 3 worked examples each
tasks.why: Hearth will turn a room's size into a shopping list.
steps: 15 formulas: paint gallons (walls + ceiling, two coats, coverage per gallon), primer, drywall sheets, joint compound, tile with waste, grout, thinset, LVP with waste, baseboard length, insulation batts, concrete bags for a slab, mulch bags, deck boards, screws per sq ft of deck, wallpaper rolls.
Each: the formula with every constant named and its source (a manufacturer's coverage page or spec sheet), then 3 worked examples with real room sizes and the answer rounded up as a store sells it.
checks: An example whose answer does not follow from its formula = the formula is sent back.
rejected_if: fewer rows than the count, or a row missing a field of the shape
a row copied from another row with the names changed
a URL that does not open, is a front page or a search page, or does not say what the row claims
a quote that is not on the page it cites (Claude opens 10 rows at random)
a file saved anywhere but the folder named here, or under another name
a constant with no source

tasks.title: Second reader on Gemini's scan-app table
tasks.why: Prices and export rules change often; a second reader catches what one missed.
inputs: Gemini's file hearth_gemini_scan-apps_*.md in the incoming folder (once it is there)
steps: Check every price, export and LiDAR cell against the cited page.
Write one line per cell you checked: row, column, Gemini's value, yours, the URL, agree/differ.

deliver.shape: table: app | column | gemini | grok | url | agree/differ

tasks.done_when: At least 32 cells checked (4 per app).
rejected_if: a row copied from another row with the names changed
a source URL that does not open or does not say what the row claims
fewer items than the count
a file saved anywhere but the folder named here, or under another name
